display_priority_rule: Among discovery contrasts with >=8 images and >=3 buildings, top three per route/context ranked by within-minus-cross original main stability gap, then image support, then lexicographic vectors. This is discovery selection; report matching assessment capacity and all outcomes, including reversals/missingness.
eligibility: Exact method/domain/context/n/m/A full vector/C full vector observed on >=3 discovery images and >=2 buildings; keep all candidates. No image results alter the frozen seven classification routes or assessment requests.
limitations: Randomly sampled mixed-vector interventions; changed category slots and B/C actual member turnover differ. A/B and A/C each replace exactly m from the same core. Assessment reuses v2 and is not external blind testing.
